headline: Tax authority demands northern businesses return 240 million shekels
summary: The Tax Authority is seeking the return of about 238.4 million shekels in compensation and advances paid to 3,751 business owners in northern Israel during the Iron Swords war.
why: The Israel Tax Authority administers tax collection and war-related compensation payments to businesses in Israel.
